visualCharacteristics.structure: Centred quotation between large navy quotation-mark glyphs; grey centred two-line attribution (name, role) below.

contentPattern.default: row 1 = quotation (one paragraph, richtext); row 2 = attribution (paragraph 1 = name, paragraph 2 = role)

usage.context: Pull quote inside news article bodies.

reuseGuidance: Use for a spokesperson pull quote in article copy: quotation in the first row, name and role as two paragraphs in the second row. Omit the second row for an unattributed quote.
